epistemic_status: DIAGNOSTIC MEASUREMENT. Tests whether related quotes jointly satisfy the no-arbitrage relations the M00 taxonomy implies. An incoherence is a timestamped observation about quotes, not an executable opportunity claim.

universe.definition: one instant = (event_id, bookmaker key, batch requested_ts) with h2h AND spreads AND totals ALL present in that single poll batch for that book
universe.live_ladder_contribution: ZERO -- data/market_snapshots/snapshots.csv has no h2h/spreads/totals rows; see inventory.json

A_favorite_sign_coherence.name: favorite_sign_coherence
A_favorite_sign_coherence.assumed_model: NONE (model-free ordinal identity: moneyline favorite team must equal spread favorite team)
A_favorite_sign_coherence.note: n_violation_raw includes moneyline exact-pickem cases (p_home_nv==p_away_nv, i.e. no moneyline favorite exists to compare) mechanically mislabeled as disagreements by the argmax tie-break. n_violation_genuine excludes those. See REPORT_BODY.md.

B_normal_margin_coherence.name: normal_margin_moneyline_spread_coherence
B_normal_margin_coherence.assumed_model: Margin ~ Normal(mu=spread_magnitude, sigma); model P(fav wins)=Phi(mu/sigma); sigma self-calibrated as median(mu_i / Phi^-1(p_fav_ml,i)) over this archive (not sourced from realized outcomes or any external dataset).
B_normal_margin_coherence.inequality: abs(p_fav_ml - Phi(mu / sigma_hat)) <= epsilon  [reported at multiple epsilon, none validated as a noise floor]

Bprime_sigma_scales_with_total_sensitivi.name: normal_margin_moneyline_spread_coherence_sigma_scales_with_total
Bprime_sigma_scales_with_total_sensitivi.assumed_model: sigma(T) = 13.7043 + 0.003937*T, OLS-fit to (T, implied_sigma) pairs from this archive only
Bprime_sigma_scales_with_total_sensitivi.note: Sensitivity check only. If b1 is near 0 and the exceedance profile matches relation_B, the constant-sigma model is not being rescued or contradicted by pace/total information.

C_cross_market_vig_consistency_descripti.name: cross_market_vig_consistency
C_cross_market_vig_consistency_descripti.assumed_model: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY -- no inequality asserted as a violation criterion; a book is free to price different market types with different overround.

D_cross_book_dispersion_same_instant.name: cross_book_dispersion_same_instant
D_cross_book_dispersion_same_instant.assumed_model: DESCRIPTIVE. 'Large dispersion' flag thresholds (spread range > 2.0 pts OR total range > 3.0 pts) are a judgment call, not a validated arbitrage boundary.

cross_quote_latency_window.note: Within-poll latency between h2h/spreads/totals last_update timestamps at the SAME book, SAME batch. This is metadata attached to each flag per D023 amendment 4, not a reaction-time claim.

could_not_establish: Any reaction-time, stale-window, or CLV claim -- explicitly out of scope per D023 amendment 4 and the node's stop conditions; this archive is T1_VENDOR_ASSERTED and no timing claim is made anywhere in this output.
Whether Relation A/B violations are actually exploitable -- execution feasibility belongs to M21 per this node's acceptance criteria; not assessed here.

M05 event-market linkage keys -- experiments/market_program/M05_EVENT_MARKET_LINKAGE/ does not exist in this worktree at the time of this run, so quotes were joined on the archive's native (event_id, bookmaker key, batch requested_ts) tuple instead. This is a deviation from the acceptance criterion 'quotes are joined through the M05 linkage keys' caused by an upstream dependency gap, not resolved by this node.

Whether featured_backfill.jsonl is or is not the specific 'final-state odds archive' (813-game, one-snapshot-per-game) referenced in the M00 contract prompt text -- experiments/market_program/M00_MARKET_PROGRAM_CONTRACT/ does not exist in this worktree, so the bounded-uses ruling could not be checked against its actual frozen bytes.
